title: Console first screen: home, object list and record page miss the 2.5 s LCP threshold (baseline 3.6 / 4.6 / 4.2 s); re-measure on a production build first
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Source: maintainer.

> 开提速卡，不派发

(Irene, in this project, 2026-11-26. "File the speed-up card, do not dispatch it." So this card waits in `pm:queue` unclaimed; seat 2 does not dispatch it.)

Business reason: first-screen load is core feature ux ⑥. The maintainer set its threshold (ruling 7178954860 on #35212): LCP at most 2.5 s, cold cache, signed in, desktop Chrome, Lighthouse desktop profile (about 10 Mbps / 40 ms RTT, no CPU throttle), median of 5 runs on home, an object list and a record page. The checklist item that encodes it, `ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp` (PR #37398, merged), fails on all three pages at its baseline. Every user opening the Console waits on this.

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` lane, when cards are taken again. Its first step is the production re-measure below; the fix scope follows from that reading.

Dedupe: open issues for `first screen LCP`, `console bundle size`, `page load time`, `Lighthouse`, `LCP`, `eager bundle`: 0 open hits. Closed and related (earlier work on the same seam, not this threshold): #33293 (dashboard route's eager closure, 17.9 s at 1.5 Mbps), #35455 (about six serial boot round trips), #35534 (me/localization waits on the eager bundle).

## Baseline (from PR #37398)

| | |
|:--|:--|
| Commit | `db77cc493a` (main) |
| App | showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, Console rebuilt with `pnpm console:build` |
| Tool | Lighthouse 13.6.0, `desktop-config.js`, performance only; Chrome for Testing 158, headless, 4-core cloud container |

| Page | Median LCP of 5 | Threshold |
|:--|--:|--:|
| Home (`/_console/home`) | 3557 ms | 2500 ms |
| Object list (`/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task`) | 4625 ms | 2500 ms |
| Record page (`.../showcase_task/record/:id`) | 4175 ms | 2500 ms |

All three miss by 42% to 85%.

## Suspected seam

The Console's eager JS: about 2.0 to 2.5 MB brotli across 150 to 239 script requests per page, loaded before the first screen paints (the measuring dev's reading in PR #37398).

## First step: re-measure on a production build

The baseline ran against the dev server in a headless container, so the gap may differ on a production deployment. Before any fix, take the same reading (same profile, same three pages, median of 5) on a production build and record it on this card. If all three pages then pass, close this card with that reading. If not, scope the fix from the production numbers and the request waterfall.

## Done when

On a production build, under the ruling's conditions, the median LCP of 5 runs is at most 2500 ms on home, the object list and the record page; the run is recorded against `ux-conventions.first-screen-lcp`.

Grade: area:ux · Bug · core feature ux ⑥ fails its maintainer-set threshold · reach: Lighthouse on the three Console pages · evidence: measured (dev-server build). Suggested-grade: p2 until the production reading confirms the miss; re-grade by the table then.
Clause-②: no
